title: Herpes (HSV)
summary: Herpes is a common viral infection (HSV) that can cause painful blisters on the mouth or genitals. It isn't curable, but medicine reduces outbreaks and transmission, and many people have mild or no symptoms.
key_points: It can spread by skin contact even when no sores are visible.
Condoms reduce but don't fully prevent it.
